D: A year in the life of students at Ridgemont High in California.
P: Serve the pizza when Spicoli has it delivered to history class.
S: delivered straight to Mr. Hand's class
Rounds of pizza dough topped with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 230C for 8 minutes, served in a pizza box.
Soft pretzels brushed with butter and coarse salt, warmed at 200C, with a warm cheese sauce of cheddar melted into evaporated milk.
Brad's job at the fish and chips shop, in the pirate hat
Flathead strips in beer batter fried at 180C, chips, tartare and lemon in paper cones.
M: Pepperoni and mushroom New York pie on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, sliced and delivered to the table in the box.
the burger joint at the mall
Thick chuck patty, cheddar, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles on a toasted sesame bun, fries alongside.
W: the cookie stand at the food court
Big soft choc chip cookies, brown butter dough rested overnight, baked at 180C for 11 minutes.
K: the mall food court, all summer
Strawberries blended with milk, vanilla and ice into a frothy food court shake.

s.note: delivered straight to Mr. Hand's class
s.how: Roll out 500g pizza dough and cut into 16 rounds. Spread with pizza sauce and top with grated mozzarella and a slice of pepperoni. Bake at 230C for 8 minutes and serve in a pizza box.

Brush 4 soft pretzels with butter, sprinkle with coarse salt and warm at 200C for 5 minutes. Heat 375ml evaporated milk and stir in 200g grated cheddar until smooth. Serve warm in paper cups for dipping.

m.note: the burger joint at the mall
m.how: Shape 800g chuck mince into 4 patties and grill to medium, melting cheddar on top. Build on toasted sesame buns with iceberg, tomato, onion and pickles. Fry 1kg potatoes cut into fries, twice, and salt well.

w.note: the cookie stand at the food court
w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Scoop 10 big balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes.

d.note: the mall food court, all summer
d.how: Blend 250g hulled strawberries with 500ml milk, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and 2 cups ice until frothy and thick. Pour into 4 tall glasses straight away.
